notes: Cross-verse split on the compound preposition לְמִן. JER.7.25 fuses it into one noncompositional unit headed on מִן (Since); this verse gave from to מִן alone and marked the לְ unrepresented. The two are the same construction with the same one-English-word rendering, and rule 30 prefers the fusion to one rendered morpheme beside another marked unrepresented. Units s018 and s019 are merged; nothing else in the verse changes.
